# Semester Calendar Builder

> A free browser planner for a school semester: classes, study blocks, exams, and deadlines in one weekly grid. Built with Next.js, React, and TypeScript. Schedules are saved in the browser's local storage, with no account and no server copy.

Semester Calendar Builder writes your schedule to local storage on the device you are using. The week grid shows a typical week with color-coded event types, drag to move or resize an event, and a flag on anything that overlaps. Set a semester start and end date and you can switch between one week and the whole term.

Features: the weekly grid, recurring classes and study blocks, important dates for exams, deadlines, breaks, and finals, Smart Paste for a pasted registrar block, import from CSV, ICS, and JSON backup, export to ICS, CSV, PNG, JSON backup, and plain text, a printable schedule, dark mode, responsive layout, automatic saving to local storage, and an example semester to start from.

## Documentation

- [Next.js Documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs): React framework with App Router and static export
- [React Documentation](https://react.dev): UI library for component-based architecture
- [TypeScript Documentation](https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs): Type-safe JavaScript development
- [Tailwind CSS](https://tailwindcss.com/docs): Utility-first CSS framework for styling
- [shadcn/ui Components](https://ui.shadcn.com): Accessible component library used throughout the application
- [Lucide Icons](https://lucide.dev): Icon library for UI elements

## Features

- [date-fns Library](https://date-fns.org/docs): Date manipulation and formatting utilities
- [html2canvas](https://html2canvas.hertzen.com): HTML to canvas conversion for PNG image export
- [Sonner Toast](https://sonner.emilkowal.ski): Toast notification system for user feedback
